title: Calculate Inventory: scope Default Dimension reads by source table
summary: Report 790 Calculate Inventory now scopes Default Dimension reads by source table to prevent dimensions from unrelated locations bleeding into journal lines when item numbers and location codes collide.
key_points: Fixed cross-product filter issue where independent OR-filters on No. and Table ID caused incorrect dimension assignments
Changed to two scoped passes per table-number pair: one for items and one for locations
Added regression test verifying that unrelated location dimensions do not leak when codes match
Applied same fix to both W1 and RU layer copies of the report
Behavior unchanged when item numbers and location codes do not collide
